anchor.method: FY2026E income statement is anchored on 9M-2026 actuals (annualised 4/3 with scenario adjustments for Q4); FY2026E balance sheet grows from 9M-2026 actuals.

loan_growth_pct.note: FY2026E reflects 9M-2026 +23.8% YTD net loan expansion plus Q4; FY2027E+ tracks nominal GDP (~12-13%) + 1% penetration.

deposit_growth_pct.note: FY2026E anchored on 9M-2026 +18.8% YTD deposit growth; FY2027E+ tracks nominal GDP.

yield_on_investments_spread_over_blend_p.note: 50% tbill_364d_pct + 50% govt_bond_yield_pct from macro.csv + 0.5% spread (reflects post-DDEP bond + T-bill mix).

yield_on_loans_spread_over_policy_pct.note: policy_rate_pct from macro.csv + 8.0% credit spread (historical FY25 implied loan+cash yield ~15-19% as policy rate eased).

cost_of_funds_spread_over_tbill91_pct.note: max(1.5%, tbill_91d_pct - 2.0%), reflecting EGH's low-cost CASA deposit franchise (FY25 CoF ~3.7%).

fee_growth_pct.note: Anchored on 9M-2026 net fee income +12.8% YoY and strong digital/FX volumes.

trading_income_growth_pct.note: FY2026E normalizes down from FY2025's elevated GHS 1,605m FX/trading gain (9M-2026 = GHS 612.7m).

opex_growth_pct.note: FY2026E reflects 9M-2026 opex run-rate (down ~12% YoY on lower other opex); FY2027E+ tracks inflation_cpi_pct + 2%.

cost_of_risk_pct.note: Impairment charge / average net loans; 9M-2026 annualised CoR ~1.5% as NPLs fell to 14.99%.

tax_rate_pct.note: Effective tax rate including statutory levies (9M-2026 actual = 35.3%, FY2025 = 39.9%, FY2024 = 27.8%).

dividend_payout_pct.note: Conservative payout allowing CET1/CAR retention above 18% (FY2025 dividend paid GHS 109.7m; 9M-2026 GHS 390.3m).

target_car_pct.note: Internal target buffer above BoG 13.0% min_car_pct from macro.csv.

loan_growth_pct.note: Slower real GDP (3.0% in FY27) and tighter credit.

deposit_growth_pct.note: Slower deposit mobilization under macro stress.

yield_on_investments_spread_over_blend_p.note: Higher macro yields in downside pass through via macro.csv.

yield_on_loans_spread_over_policy_pct.note: Higher risk pricing over elevated policy rate.

cost_of_funds_spread_over_tbill91_pct.note: Deposit repricing pressure under tighter liquidity.

opex_growth_pct.note: Higher CPI inflation (11.0% in FY27) and cedi depreciation pass-through to IT/vendor costs.

cost_of_risk_pct.note: NPL stress under higher rates and slower growth.

loan_growth_pct.note: Stronger real GDP (5.5-6.0%) and credit demand.

yield_on_investments_spread_over_blend_p.note: Linked to macro.csv upside yield curve.

yield_on_loans_spread_over_policy_pct.note: Gradual spread compression as credit quality improves.

dividend_payout_pct.note: Higher payout supported by strong capital generation.
